resources.string: \"Clean up\" shows the steps that remove what a guide added, as the same kind of cards. Nothing is removed until you tap a card.
Tap to run (Ctrl-C first, so a half-typed line cannot mix in) / ✕ to keep it
Remove the automation rules that call this macro
Remove the macro (stops without removing it if you edited it yourself)
If nothing else uses it: Settings -> turn off \"Notification detection\"
If nothing else uses it: Settings -> turn off \"SMS detection\"
Empty the tile slots that run remind.sh
Delete the reminder records (✕ to keep them)
Delete the feed list and the collected articles (✕ to keep them)
Delete voice command\'s word table, notes and settings (✕ to keep them)
Delete the sample app panel \"main\" (items you added to it go too)
Delete the sample panels (the text in the note goes too)
If you use no other panel, turn panels off (the bar disappears)
\"Display over other apps\" and accessibility can only be turned off in Android settings. Leave them on if another feature uses them.
